notes: fix-57 completed: Star Gate travel + fuel range integration per design/galaxy/travel.md. Star gates use ETA=1 instant travel. getFleetFuelRange() uses actual fuel cells + bonus tanks instead of hardcoded 50 in StarMap.

tests_added: systemHasStarGate: returns false if system has no planets
systemHasStarGate: returns false if planet has no star gate
systemHasStarGate: returns true if planet has star gate owned by empire
systemHasStarGate: returns false if star gate planet owned by different empire
systemHasStarGate: returns false for uncolonized planet with star gate
canUseStarGateTravel: returns true when both systems have star gates
canUseStarGateTravel: returns false when origin has no star gate
canUseStarGateTravel: returns false when destination has no star gate
canUseStarGateTravel: returns false when destination gate owned by different empire
calculateEta: returns ETA=1 for star gate travel regardless of distance
calculateEta: returns normal ETA when star gates not available
moveFleet: sets ETA=1 when using star gate travel
getShipFuelRange: returns base range from fuel cell (standard = 4 parsecs)
getShipFuelRange: returns base + bonus for fuel cell + reserve tanks (+3)
getShipFuelRange: returns base + bonus for fuel cell + extended tanks (+5)
getShipFuelRange: returns Infinity for ship with thorium_cells
getFleetFuelRange: returns the minimum range ship in the fleet

worker_output.summary: Implemented Star Gate travel and fuel range per design/galaxy/travel.md. Added systemHasStarGate(), canUseStarGateTravel(), getShipFuelRange(), getFleetFuelRange() to fleet.ts. calculateEta() now returns 1 turn for star gate travel. StarMap.ts uses actual fleet fuel range instead of hardcoded 50 for pathfinding. Note: extended_reserve_tanks uses bonusRange=5 per components-complete.md (travel.md says +6 - design gap documented).

design_compliance.quote: Ships travel instantly between any gated planets. Ignores fuel range for gate-to-gate travel.
Reserve Fuel Tanks: +3 parsecs to ship range

design_gaps.gap: Extended Fuel Tank range bonus conflict: design/galaxy/travel.md says +6 parsecs, design/ships/components-complete.md says +5 range. Implementation uses +5 (components-complete.md as more specific spec). Needs human review to resolve canonical value.
